title: A Passage for the Compass
author: Hazel Sandoval
blurb: Edmund Joubert, a riverboat captain who knows every sandbar's mood, carries a compass, a debt, and very little else. Then an expedition upriver stops answering the radio — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must cross the range ahead of the snows before the monsoon makes landfall.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
